def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    n = len(customers)
    if n == 0:
        return []

    # Deterministic clarke-wright savings with capacity and end-merge only
    # Keeps feasibility: never merges violating capacity.
    routes = []
    route_of = [-1] * (max(instance["customer_ids"]) + 1 if instance["customer_ids"] else 0)
    # In case customer ids are not compact, use dict mapping instead of array
    route_of = {}
    route_load = []
    for i in customers:
        r = [i]
        routes.append(r)
        route_load.append(demands[i])
        route_of[i] = len(routes) - 1

    # Savings list
    savings = []
    for a in range(n):
        i = customers[a]
        di = matrix[depot][i]
        for b in range(a + 1, n):
            j = customers[b]
            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            # tie-break deterministic: higher saving, then smaller i, then smaller j
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))

    def route_ends(r):
        return r[0], r[-1]

    def reverse_route_if_needed(r, target_front):
        # target_front: if True, ensure r[0] is the merge node; else ensure r[-1] is merge node.
        # We will use this only when merge uses a specific end.
        # Not used directly for safety; merge logic handles orientation by reversing whole route.
        pass

    # Merge procedure
    for s, i, j in savings:
        ri = route_of.get(i, -1)
        rj = route_of.get(j, -1)
        if ri < 0 or rj < 0 or ri == rj:
            continue
        ri_list = routes[ri]
        rj_list = routes[rj]
        load = route_load[ri] + route_load[rj]
        if load > capacity:
            continue

        i_front, i_back = ri_list[0], ri_list[-1]
        j_front, j_back = rj_list[0], rj_list[-1]

        merged = False
        new_route = None

        # Case 1: i is back end and j is front end => i ... + j ...
        if i_back == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list
            merged = True
        # Case 2: i is back end and j is back end => i ... + reverse(j route)
        elif i_back == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True
        # Case 3: i is front end and j is front end => reverse(i route) + j ...
        elif i_front == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list
            merged = True
        # Case 4: i is front end and j is back end => reverse(i route) + reverse(j route)? Actually
        # want ... + ... with i at appropriate end:
        # i_front == i means route starts with i. To connect to j_back == j, we need reverse(i route)??:
        # If we reverse i route, i moves to back end. Then i_back (after reverse) matches i, and j_back matches j at end of j route,
        # but we need j at front end for direct concatenation, so reverse j route.
        elif i_front == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True

        if not merged:
            continue

        # Apply merge: mark rj removed and update mappings.
        routes[ri] = new_route
        route_load[ri] = load
        # Update route_of for nodes in rj
        for node in rj_list:
            route_of[node] = ri
        routes[rj] = None

    routes = [r for r in routes if r is not None]

    # Local search: deterministic relocate between routes (conservative, maintains feasibility)
    # Use limited passes to keep runtime bounded.
    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for k in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]]
        return c

    # Precompute loads
    loads = [sum(demands[node] for node in r) for r in routes]
    # Cost cache
    costs = [route_cost(r) for r in routes]

    # Build customer position lookup per route for fast removals not needed; we do simple scans.
    # Attempt improvements: move single customer from one route into another at best feasible position.
    # Keep only first improving move per (from_route, to_route) in deterministic order.
    max_passes = 2
    for _ in range(max_passes):
        improved_any = False
        R = len(routes)
        # If too many routes (can happen in bottleneck cases), relocate may help; still deterministic.
        for a in range(R):
            ra = routes[a]
            if not ra:
                continue
            for idx in range(len(ra)):
                node = ra[idx]
                # Remove node from ra
                for b in range(R):
                    if b == a:
                        continue
                    rb = routes[b]
                    if rb is None:
                        continue
                    if loads[b] + demands[node] > capacity:
                        continue

                    # Determine best insertion position in rb that reduces total cost (or smallest increase, but accept only improving)
                    # Compute cost delta efficiently by trying positions.
                    base_cost_a = costs[a]
                    base_cost_b = costs[b]

                    # Cost of removing node from ra:
                    # recompute by cases in O(1) using neighbors
                    left = ra[idx - 1] if idx - 1 >= 0 else depot
                    right = ra[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < len(ra) else depot
                    # edge left->node and node->right removed; edge left->right added
                    rem_delta_a = -matrix[left][node] - matrix[node][right] + matrix[left][right]
                    new_cost_a = base_cost_a + rem_delta_a

                    # insertion into rb at position p (between rb[p-1] and rb[p]), p in [0..len(rb)]
                    # try all positions deterministically; pick best improving.
                    best_delta = None
                    best_p = None
                    Lrb = len(rb)
                    for p in range(Lrb + 1):
                        ins_left = rb[p - 1] if p - 1 >= 0 else depot
                        ins_right = rb[p] if p < Lrb else depot
                        ins_delta_b = -matrix[ins_left][ins_right] + matrix[ins_left][node] + matrix[node][ins_right]
                        total_delta = (new_cost_a + (base_cost_b + ins_delta_b)) - (base_cost_a + base_cost_b)

                        if best_delta is None or total_delta < best_delta - 1e-12 or (abs(total_delta - best_delta) <= 1e-12 and p < best_p):
                            best_delta = total_delta
                            best_p = p

                    if best_delta is None or best_delta >= -1e-12:
                        continue

                    # Apply move
                    new_ra = ra[:idx] + ra[idx + 1:]
                    new_rb = rb[:best_p] + [node] + rb[best_p:]
                    routes[a] = new_ra
                    routes[b] = new_rb
                    loads[a] -= demands[node]
                    loads[b] += demands[node]

                    costs[a] = new_cost_a
                    # update cost_b
                    # compute new cost_b exactly using insertion delta
                    costs[b] = base_cost_b + (best_delta - (new_cost_a - base_cost_a))
                    improved_any = True
                    break
                if improved_any:
                    break
            if improved_any:
                break
        if not improved_any:
            break

    # Final cleanup: remove empty routes
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]

    return routes

        for b in range(a + 1, n):

            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))

        rj = route_of.get(j, -1)
        if ri < 0 or rj < 0 or ri == rj:
            continue
        ri_list = routes[ri]
        rj_list = routes[rj]
        load = route_load[ri] + route_load[rj]
        if load > capacity:
            continue

        i_front, i_back = ri_list[0], ri_list[-1]
        j_front, j_back = rj_list[0], rj_list[-1]

        merged = False
        if i_back == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list
            merged = True
        elif i_back == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True
        elif i_front == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list
            merged = True
        elif i_front == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True

        if not merged:
            continue

        routes[ri] = new_route
        route_load[ri] = load
        for node in rj_list:
            route_of[node] = ri
        routes[rj] = None

    routes = [r for r in routes if r is not None]

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]

def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    n = len(customers)
    if n == 0:
        return []

    # Clarke-Wright savings with capacity and end-merge only (deterministic)
    routes = []
    route_of = {}
    route_load = []
    for i in customers:
        routes.append([i])
        route_load.append(demands[i])
        route_of[i] = len(routes) - 1

    savings = []
    for a in range(n):
        i = customers[a]
        di = matrix[depot][i]
        for b in range(a + 1, n):
            j = customers[b]
            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))

    for s, i, j in savings:
        ri = route_of.get(i, -1)
        rj = route_of.get(j, -1)
        if ri < 0 or rj < 0 or ri == rj:
            continue
        ri_list = routes[ri]
        rj_list = routes[rj]
        load = route_load[ri] + route_load[rj]
        if load > capacity:
            continue

        i_front, i_back = ri_list[0], ri_list[-1]
        j_front, j_back = rj_list[0], rj_list[-1]

        merged = False
        if i_back == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list
            merged = True
        elif i_back == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True
        elif i_front == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list
            merged = True
        elif i_front == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True

        if not merged:
            continue

        routes[ri] = new_route
        route_load[ri] = load
        for node in rj_list:
            route_of[node] = ri
        routes[rj] = None

    routes = [r for r in routes if r is not None]

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for k in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]]
        return c

    # Local improvement: conservative relocate (single-node), then deterministic 2-opt within routes,
    # then a limited feasible inter-route swap (one node each), all strictly improving.
    loads = [sum(demands[node] for node in r) for r in routes]
    costs = [route_cost(r) for r in routes]

    def try_relocate(max_passes=3):
        nonlocal routes, loads, costs
        R = len(routes)
        for _ in range(max_passes):
            improved_any = False
            R = len(routes)
            for a in range(R):
                ra = routes[a]
                if not ra:
                    continue
                base_cost_a = costs[a]
                Lra = len(ra)
                for idx in range(Lra):
                    node = ra[idx]
                    # compute cost of removing node from ra by rebuilding affected edges
                    left = ra[idx - 1] if idx - 1 >= 0 else depot
                    right = ra[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < Lra else depot
                    rem_delta_a = -matrix[left][node] - matrix[node][right] + matrix[left][right]
                    new_cost_a = base_cost_a + rem_delta_a
                    new_ra = ra[:idx] + ra[idx + 1:]
                    # try insertion into another route
                    for b in range(R):
                        if b == a:
                            continue
                        rb = routes[b]
                        if not rb:
                            continue
                        if loads[b] + demands[node] > capacity:
                            continue
                        base_cost_b = costs[b]
                        Lrb = len(rb)
                        best_delta = None
                        best_p = None
                        # insert after position p-1, before p (p in 0..Lrb)
                        for p in range(Lrb + 1):
                            ins_left = rb[p - 1] if p - 1 >= 0 else depot
                            ins_right = rb[p] if p < Lrb else depot
                            ins_delta_b = -matrix[ins_left][ins_right] + matrix[ins_left][node] + matrix[node][ins_right]
                            total_delta = (new_cost_a + (base_cost_b + ins_delta_b)) - (base_cost_a + base_cost_b)
                            if best_delta is None or total_delta < best_delta - 1e-12 or (abs(total_delta - best_delta) <= 1e-12 and p < best_p):
                                best_delta = total_delta
                                best_p = p
                        if best_delta is None or best_delta >= -1e-12:
                            continue

                        new_rb = rb[:best_p] + [node] + rb[best_p:]
                        # apply move
                        routes[a] = new_ra
                        routes[b] = new_rb
                        loads[a] -= demands[node]
                        loads[b] += demands[node]
                        # recompute costs exactly for correctness
                        costs[a] = route_cost(new_ra)
                        costs[b] = route_cost(new_rb)
                        improved_any = True
                        break
                    if improved_any:
                        break
                if improved_any:
                    break
            if not improved_any:
                break

    def try_intra_2opt(max_passes=2):
        nonlocal routes, costs
        for _ in range(max_passes):
            improved_any = False
            R = len(routes)
            for r in range(R):
                route = routes[r]
                m = len(route)
                if m < 4:
                    continue
                base_cost = costs[r]
                # first-improvement 2-opt on customer indices
                # reverse segment [i..k] inclusive
                for i in range(m - 1):
                    a = route[i - 1] if i - 1 >= 0 else depot
                    b = route[i]
                    for k in range(i + 1, m):
                        c = route[k]
                        d = route[k + 1] if k + 1 < m else depot
                        # current edges: a-b and c-d
                        # new edges: a-c and b-d
                        delta = -matrix[a][b] - matrix[c][d] + matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                        if delta < -1e-12:
                            new_route = route[:i] + route[i:k + 1][::-1] + route[k + 1:]
                            routes[r] = new_route
                            costs[r] = base_cost + delta
                            improved_any = True
                            break
                    if improved_any:
                        break
                if improved_any:
                    break
            if not improved_any:
                break

    def try_inter_swap(max_checks=2000):
        nonlocal routes, loads, costs
        checks = 0
        R = len(routes)
        best_improved = True
        while best_improved and checks < max_checks:
            best_improved = False
            R = len(routes)
            for a in range(R):
                ra = routes[a]
                if not ra:
                    continue
                for b in range(R):
                    if b == a:
                        continue
                    rb = routes[b]
                    if not rb:
                        continue
                    base_cost_a = costs[a]
                    base_cost_b = costs[b]
                    # capacities after swap
                    load_a = loads[a] - 0
                    load_b = loads[b] - 0
                    for ia in range(len(ra)):
                        node_a = ra[ia]
                        for ib in range(len(rb)):
                            node_b = rb[ib]
                            if loads[a] - demands[node_a] + demands[node_b] > capacity:
                                continue
                            if loads[b] - demands[node_b] + demands[node_a] > capacity:
                                continue
                            # perform swap and check strict improvement by exact cost recompute (still cheap for small routes)
                            new_ra = ra[:]
                            new_rb = rb[:]
                            new_ra[ia] = node_b
                            new_rb[ib] = node_a
                            new_cost_a = route_cost(new_ra)
                            new_cost_b = route_cost(new_rb)
                            if (new_cost_a + new_cost_b) < (base_cost_a + base_cost_b) - 1e-12:
                                routes[a] = new_ra
                                routes[b] = new_rb
                                loads[a] = loads[a] - demands[node_a] + demands[node_b]
                                loads[b] = loads[b] - demands[node_b] + demands[node_a]
                                costs[a] = new_cost_a
                                costs[b] = new_cost_b
                                best_improved = True
                                checks += 1
                                break
                        if best_improved:
                            break
                    if best_improved:
                        break
                if best_improved:
                    break
            # loop continues until no improvement or checks exhausted

    try_relocate(max_passes=3)
    try_intra_2opt(max_passes=2)
    try_inter_swap(max_checks=600)

    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    return routes
